title: Reasoning Multi-Agent Behavioral Topology for Interactive Autonomous Driving (BeTop)
authors: Haochen Liu; Li Chen; Yu Qiao; Chen Lv; Hongyang Li
formal_date_status: Published 2024; arXiv v1 Sep 26 2024 is pre-window but formal conference paper is in-window
mechanism: Future trajectories are graph nodes; braid/intertwine topology edges distinguish assertive/passive yielding relations; topology-guided local attention and contingency planning.
verified_quantitative_evidence: Test14-Inter reactive PDMScore 0.894 vs PlanTF 0.871; 1340 15-second scenes. Test14-Random closed-loop average 0.878 vs 0.847.
closed_loop_evidence: Yes; nuPlan reactive and non-reactive closed-loop; released full prediction but planning pipeline listed TODO.
scope_or_limit: Strong overlap for future interaction topology, multi-agent yielding structure, topology-guided attention and closed-loop planning. Not SAC critic evidence.

title: SWIFT: A Small-World Interaction Framework for Flow-Aware Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
authors: Chengyue Wang; Bin Rao; Haicheng Liao; Bonan Wang; Chengzhong Xu; Zhenning Li
formal_date_status: arXiv v1 dated 2026-07-03; PubMed records TPAMI Oct 2026 but exact online day not verified by 2026-10-03 cutoff
mechanism: Directed agent graph; structural small-world optimization plus learned edge refinement; traffic regime encoder adjusts local/global connectivity; direct, co-influenced and co-influencing interaction channels.
verified_quantitative_evidence: nuScenes minADE5 1.15 vs 1.24; MoCAD 5s RMSE 2.36 vs 2.88; removing interaction reasoning raises nuScenes minFDE1 6.73 to 7.37.
scope_or_limit: Closest generic vehicle-interaction-graph prior art; exact TPAMI day and official code not confirmed.

title: Future-Aware Interaction Network for Motion Forecasting (FINet)
authors: Shijie Li; Chunyu Liu; Xun Xu; Si Yong Yeo; Xulei Yang
mechanism: Potential future-trajectory tokens participate in scene interaction; adaptive reorder for Mamba spatial modeling; temporal Mamba refines decoded futures.
verified_quantitative_evidence: AV2 test minADE6/minFDE6/MR6 0.66/1.27/0.15; QCNet 0.65/1.29/0.16. RTX A5000 batch-1: 17.72ms and 3.7M params vs 54.55ms and 7.7M.
scope_or_limit: Future-in-scene encoding is prior art; GT endpoint supervision is a training label and must not leak into live policy input.

title: NEST: A Neuromodulated Small-world Hypergraph Trajectory Prediction Model for Autonomous Driving
authors: Chengyue Wang; Haicheng Liao; Bonan Wang; Yanchen Guan; Bin Rao; Ziyuan Pu; Zhiyong Cui; Cheng-Zhong Xu; Zhenning Li
mechanism: Agent vertices and group hyperedges; small-world network; density/features modulate threshold and connection probability; vertex-to-hyperedge-to-vertex aggregation.
verified_quantitative_evidence: nuScenes minADE5 1.18; MoCAD 5s RMSE 2.42 vs BAT 2.88; HighD 4s/5s gains over BAT reported as 27.3%/22.6%; 12-agent inference 11.6ms on RTX3090.
scope_or_limit: Direct high-order interaction and uncertainty-like dynamic hyperedge prior; inference timing comparator hardware differs and code availability unverified.

title: ModeSeq: Taming Sparse Multimodal Motion Prediction with Sequential Mode Modeling
authors: Zikang Zhou; Hengjian Zhou; Haibo Hu; Zihao Wen; Jianping Wang; Yung-Hui Li; Yu-Kai Huang
mechanism: Autoregressive/sequential mode embeddings plus iterative refinement and Early-Match-Take-All labels to improve mode diversity and confidence scoring.
verified_quantitative_evidence: WOMD val Soft-mAP6 0.4562 vs QCNet 0.4508, minADE6 0.5237 vs 0.5122; AV2 minADE6/minFDE6 0.63/1.26 vs QCNet 0.65/1.29.
scope_or_limit: Addresses multimodal mode dependence, but modes are per-agent prediction outputs and do not themselves define a scene-level joint distribution; official code not located.

title: RAP: Role-Aware Joint Prediction and Planning in Autonomous Driving
authors: Xiaolong Tang; Meina Kan; Shiguang Shan; Xilin Chen
formal_date_status: Formal issue Feb 2026; paper filename says 2025 but volume/issue is 2026
mechanism: GNN nodes include AV, agents and lanes; route-identity token pairing; ego-only safety losses; ego-history/kinematic perturbation for feedback robustness.
verified_quantitative_evidence: Ablation without ego history/kinematic perturbation: open-loop OS +1.45 while closed-loop NRS -15.35; full three-component model FS=79.75.
closed_loop_evidence: Yes; nuPlan open- and closed-loop planning benchmarks.
scope_or_limit: Useful planning-role and feedback prior, but not resource event graph or SAC critic; keep formal 2026 date.

title: GraphAD: Interaction Scene Graph for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
mechanism: Per-actor future mode nodes; synchronous future distance agent graph; future proposal-to-map graph; multimodal perception/planning system.
verified_quantitative_evidence: nuScenes open-loop planning average L2 0.68m and collision 0.12%; motion forecasting DSG+SSG minADE/minFDE/MR 0.665/0.989/0.160.
closed_loop_evidence: Open-loop planning reported; not SAC closed-loop representation evidence.
scope_or_limit: Deeply reviewed in companion literature_topology.md; hardest two-graph/future-mode novelty blocker.

title: Sim-to-Real Causal Transfer: A Metric Learning Approach to Causally-Aware Interaction Representations
authors: Ahmad Rahimi; Po-Chien Luan; Yuejiang Liu; Frano Rajic; Alexandre Alahi
formal_date_status: Published CVPR 2025, pp.17271-17281; arXiv first version 2023-12 is pre-window
mechanism: Contrastive/ranking causal regularizers learn direct/indirect/non-causal social relation sensitivity and transfer simulator causal annotations to real prediction.
verified_quantitative_evidence: With 25% ETH-UCY real data, ORCA sim-to-real ranking avg ADE/FDE 0.516/1.063 vs AutoBots 0.539/1.113.
scope_or_limit: Primary focus includes pedestrian/crowd social motion; causal annotations and transferability are domain assumptions, not direct junction-vehicle evidence.

title: Beyond Patterns: Harnessing Causal Logic for Autonomous Driving Trajectory Prediction
authors: Bonan Wang; Haicheng Liao; Chengyue Wang; Bin Rao; Yanchen Guan; Guyang Yu; Jiaxun Zhang; Songning Lai; Chengzhong Xu; Zhenning Li
venue: IJCAI Special Track: AI and Social Good
mechanism: Separates spatial map and temporal agent factors; diffusion backdoor adjustment, counterfactual token and multimodal causal decoder.
scope_or_limit: Causal spatial/temporal fusion is related but not a conflict-resource/event graph or closed-loop decision representation.

title: Curb Your Attention: Causal Attention Gating for Robust Trajectory Prediction (CRiTIC)
authors: Ehsan Ahmadi; Ray Mercurius; Soheil Alizadeh; Kasra Rezaee; Amir Rasouli
mechanism: Causal-discovery estimates inter-agent relations over history and gates transformer attention.
verified_quantitative_evidence: Abstract reports robustness improvements up to 54% and cross-domain up to 29% without significant prediction-accuracy loss; exact evaluation metric/table not transcribed here.
scope_or_limit: Causal gating prior; linked GitHub appears to be a project page/template rather than confirmed algorithm code; detailed benchmark definition not transcribed.

title: CarPlanner: Consistent Auto-regressive Trajectory Planning for Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving
authors: Dongkun Zhang; Jiaming Liang; Ke Guo; Sha Lu; Qi Wang; Rong Xiong; Zhenwei Miao; Yue Wang
mechanism: Autoregressive planning trajectory modes and PPO policy-gradient refinement; interaction graph is not its central contribution.
verified_quantitative_evidence: Paper reports closed-loop nuPlan planning metrics and uses gamma 0.1, lambda 0.9 for trajectory-level PPO.
scope_or_limit: Useful RL/planning evidence but different action parameterization, data scale and algorithm; no SAC critic representation result.

title: T2SG: Traffic Topology Scene Graph for Topology Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
authors: Changsheng Lv; Mengshi Qi; Liang Liu; Huadong Ma
mechanism: Directed lane topology graph with lane-signal relations; TopoFormer reasons lane structure from camera/map inputs.
scope_or_limit: Static map topology prior; not dynamic agent interaction or policy value evidence.

title: Flow Matching-Based Autonomous Driving Planning with Advanced Interactive Behavior Modeling (Flow Planner)
mechanism: Flow-matching planner models interactive behaviors with spatial-temporal planning/scene fusion and behavior guidance.
verified_quantitative_evidence: This pass checked the official abstract only; no exact numeric claim transcribed.
closed_loop_evidence: Closed-loop planning is reported in the paper; not reviewed deeply here.
scope_or_limit: A relevant closed-loop planner neighbor but abstract-level only and not explicit event-graph SAC evidence.

title: QCNeXt: A Next-Generation Framework for Joint Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
authors: Zikang Zhou; Zihao Wen; Jianping Wang; Yung-Hui Li; Yu-Kai Huang
venue: arXiv technical report; CVPR 2023 Workshop challenge
formal_date_status: Outside window; arXiv 2023-06 and CVPR 2023 workshop
mechanism: Query-centric invariant scene encoding and DETR-like joint multi-agent decoder that models interactions at future time steps.
verified_quantitative_evidence: Ranked 1st in AV2 Multi-Agent Challenge per report.
scope_or_limit: Older but mandatory novelty anchor for joint futures, relative-coordinate invariance and future interaction decoding; QCNet repository is the base method implementation, not confirmed QCNeXt-specific code.
